scope: Read-only targeted local search requested by user; no secrets or unrelated document contents included.
method: rg --files -uuu and rg --no-ignore --hidden with calibration/intrinsic/measurement/jaw/hold/release/trace/landmark patterns; cat of plausible JSON/YAML/CSV; source vs fitted provenance reviewed.
exclusions: Git internals, virtualenv/package caches, node_modules, weight files, unrelated private document contents. Robot CAD inspected only for provenance and nominal transforms.

candidate_evidence.interpretation: Contains independently supplied scalar table/mat/camera distance-height/bowl measurements; fitted focal length/pose, provisional joint zeros and nominal jaw conversion are separate.
Actual encoder homing offsets and endpoint ranges, not measured physical joint-axis zeros or jaw gaps.
Actual leader encoder homing offsets/ranges; commands can be limiter-generated and are not readbacks.
Backup uses different endpoints/homing; no independent source-image/metric-jaw registration.
Filename says measured, but focal/orientation/camera-X/mat placement were fitted to provisional FK and mat pixels. Joint RMS77.574px, mat RMS40.785px.
Real image joint-horn pixels with15-25px uncertainty; no independently registered camera/task XYZ and not v2 physical acceptance.
Explicitly APPROXIMATE_INDEPENDENT_IMAGE_JAW_TIPS_NOT_PHYSICAL_CALIBRATION.10px uncertainty and uncertain fixed/moving jaw identity; not metric gap measurements.
Nominal metric CAD anchors; physical_identity_verified=false, image associations unverified.
Frame start/end fields empty; not measured loaded/unloaded hold intervals.
Camera intrinsics/transforms, measured jaw openings, loaded trace sessions and hold frames unfilled.
Independent static/joint/wrist measured correspondence slots unfilled.
Static xyz0.2,0,0.60 and wrist xyz0,0,-0.02 are configurable defaults; no intrinsics or distortion.
Generated using onshape-to-robot.5degree offset comment is not an independent measured-pose record.

finding: Actual scalar operator measurements and motor encoder calibrations were located and retained. Additional independent source-resolution intrinsics/distortion, registered static/joint metric correspondence, measured jaw-gap openings and physical loaded hold/release traces did not surface in the searched locations. This does not establish absence elsewhere.
